There are always many people at the chess corner. Tom and Jack had great fun there. Tom learned a lot about music. Also, grandma loves opera on Saturday radio.
Tom usually has dumplings for breakfast. It takes twenty minutes to get to the photo club by bike. Life is full of small surprises. For example, the street musician played an old song.
The photo club is one of the best places in the city. Tom's favorite animal is the elephant. Jack is interested in dancing. In fact, pop songs help you learn English.
Tom is reading a book about music. Tom hopes to visit Paris one day. Tom wrote about the day in the diary.
